page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

The processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512_VNNI, alongside cryptographic acceleration features like AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates solid compute capabilities, achieving a stress-ng single-core score of 1854.09 and a multi-core score of 31066.87. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1675.96 GB/sec, which drops to 154.46 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and a write bandwidth of 67.93 GB/sec.

With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7nex.8xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The instance performs well in multi-threaded decompression tasks, as evidenced by a bzip3 multi-threaded decompression throughput of 161.88 GB/sec, and high-throughput web serving, reaching 32.08 GB/sec in static web serving benchmarks. This makes it highly suitable for high-traffic web servers, batch processing, compilation tasks, and cryptographic workloads.
